notes: All 55 raster originals in Img/ were visually inventoried. Hidden .DS_Store files are not images.
Img/Agromapa/Portada.png depicts Comercio 45, so it belongs to the Comercio 45 gallery and is used as that project's cover.
Img/Sistemadistribuidoras/Crear nota de debito.png depicts the new credit-note form. Its alternative text follows the visible content.
The existing avatar is a portrait illustration on a black background, not a photograph. Its original aspect ratio is preserved.
The two decorative backgrounds Img/Fondo.png and Img/Sobremi.png are inventoried but excluded from project galleries.

Some existing screenshots contain contact details and names or identifiers in financial tables. They are preserved without visual edits; privacy review remains advisable before a new public deployment.
The AgroMapa climate screenshot includes an existing map load error. Its description reflects the climate indicators and its original content is preserved.
All generated images preserve aspect ratios, never upscale originals, and omit source EXIF metadata.
